propositions: Twenty-four instances of the predates-gate shell guard exist across six workflow files, with inconsistent application and drifting copies causing defects like missing or misplaced guards.

A shared owner (composite action, shell helper, Python module) cannot serve the predates-gate guard because it is absent on pre-gate trees where the guard is needed, causing existing test failure in empty-directory execution.

Every gate step that runs repo-local code must carry either an explicit `-f` guard with the canonical skip message or a mandatory-reason `# predates-gate-ok:` marker; seven steps initially violated this invariant.

Each guarded step must exit 0 and print the canonical 'change predates the gate' message when executed in an empty directory, formalizing and generalizing the mutation-selector parity test across all gates.

Genuine guard gaps discovered during audit (unguarded `test.yml` golden-path steps and unguarded `_optionality.yml` degradation-path step) are filed as separate tickets with discovered_from links rather than fixed inline, to avoid behavioral changes to which gates run on old bases.
